name: The Hierophant

fortuneText.upright: That which is handed down is older than the hand. The kneeling figure is not made small by kneeling. The room has held many before; it will hold many after.
fortuneText.reversed: The rite is performed and nothing answers. The form remains; the spirit has departed. What was once living has become its own monument.

flavor: He keeps the keys. The doors keep him.

name: The Host

fortuneText.upright: What you have built is already older than you know. The carving is finished. Whether it lasts is not your question to answer.
fortuneText.reversed: The name on the monument belongs to one who never lifted a stone. The stone does not lie. The historian will.

flavor: Names cut deep into stone. The hand that cut them is dust.

name: The Twin Suns

fortuneText.upright: Two suns are in the sky and the day is wide enough for both. Nothing here has been hidden. Nothing here has been earned.
fortuneText.reversed: The light has not gone. The figure has turned away from it. The sky keeps its part of the bargain regardless.

flavor: The child rides past the field. The horse does not stumble.

name: The Author

fortuneText.upright: The chain has the temperature of the skin it has rested against. It has been there long enough to be unnoticed. It is still a chain.
fortuneText.reversed: The link is open. Whether the wrist follows is a separate matter. Most chains outlast their use.

flavor: The chains are warm where the wrist has rested against them.

name: The Horizon

fortuneText.upright: The step has already been taken. The body has not yet caught up to it. What waits past the edge does not announce itself.
fortuneText.reversed: The horizon retreats as fast as you walk. There is nothing in the distance you did not bring with you.

flavor: The cliff falls away. The sky does not.

name: The Compelled

fortuneText.upright: The path is older than the one who walks it. The stones remember the foot that fits them. The walking is the work.
fortuneText.reversed: The road continues without him. The road does not require him. The absence is recorded the way every absence is recorded.

flavor: The footprints arrive at his feet. Each one fits.

name: The Jurist

fortuneText.upright: The scale knows what the tongue does not. The weight is placed and the truth is found on its own. The sword waits for the verdict.
fortuneText.reversed: The pan is loaded. The hand is hidden. The verdict will come, but the scale has already been taught what to say.

flavor: The sword is sharp. The scale is level. Neither has spoken yet.

name: The Judge

fortuneText.upright: The verdict is older than the trial. The scale was level long before the weight was placed. What will be true was true already.
fortuneText.reversed: A finger rests on the scale. The verdict was decided before the hearing. Every name on the bench knows it.

flavor: The ring stretches horizon to horizon. No side falls outside it.

name: The Watcher

fortuneText.upright: What is seen is preserved. What is preserved becomes the foundation of what is seen later. The line is unbroken until it is broken.
fortuneText.reversed: The records have burned before. They are burning now. What will be remembered is what someone chooses to remember.

flavor: A thousand eyes fixed on the sky. None of them blink.

name: The Pulse

fortuneText.upright: The pulse continues past the point where it should have stopped. The reason is at the bedside. The reason has not slept in days.
fortuneText.reversed: The pulse is sustained by hands that should have let go. The body is no longer in the breath. The vigil has become the only thing remaining.

flavor: She has not slept in three days. The pulse is steady because of it.

name: The Heir

fortuneText.upright: What is ending was always going to end. The cycle does not require permission. What follows has waited long enough.
fortuneText.reversed: The body has ended. The hand on it has not. The refusal costs more than the ending it was meant to prevent.

flavor: The bleeding moon rises. Below it, two doors stand open.

name: The Loam

fortuneText.upright: The roots go deeper than the frost. What was buried is still down there. What was planted is taking its time.
fortuneText.reversed: The soil has given what it can. The next crop will pull from somewhere else. The hand that planted does not know yet.

flavor: The soil is dark. The hand that turns it is darker.

name: The Wheel

fortuneText.upright: The wheel is at the angle now where the next thing arrives. What looked like luck was always the long arc of an earlier turn.
fortuneText.reversed: The grip is yours. The turn is the wheel's. One of these will give first.

flavor: It turns. Hands have rested on it; none have moved it.

name: The Beacon

fortuneText.upright: The current is already running. The vessel exists. The shape of what arrives is set the moment the circuit closes.
fortuneText.reversed: The pose is correct. The current is absent. A remembered gesture has weight only as long as someone watches.

flavor: One arm at the sky. One arm at the ground. The line between is charged.

name: The Forest

fortuneText.upright: The lion does not require taming. The hand has only to remain. The strength was here before the test arrived.
fortuneText.reversed: The hand has begun to shake. The lion has noticed. Strength remembered too late carries the same weight as strength absent.

flavor: Her hand on the great mane. The teeth are still close.

name: The Star

fortuneText.upright: She kneels at the water. The jar empties. The water continues. There is no end to what is poured here.
fortuneText.reversed: The water has stopped where she cannot see it stopping. The jar is held in the same posture. The river beneath has gone dry.

flavor: She pours and pours. The water knows where to go.

name: The World Tree

fortuneText.upright: What chooses one branch chooses every leaf on it. The wood remembers the cut for a thousand years.
fortuneText.reversed: The branches do not agree. They have not for some time. The trunk is the last thing to know.

flavor: Roots below. Branches above. A figure where they cross.

name: The Harlequin

fortuneText.upright: The shapes on the path were always stones. The moon hides this. By morning the stones remain stones, and someone has walked into the water.
fortuneText.reversed: The mask falls in the firelight. The face beneath is smaller than the mask. The fear had been wearing the wrong shape.

flavor: The path across the water looks solid by moonlight. The wolves are not fooled.

name: The Shackle

fortuneText.upright: The chain holds the wall up. The wall holds the roof up. The roof keeps the rain off the work that matters.
fortuneText.reversed: The chain has begun to shape the wrist. The wall has begun to shape the room. What was meant to support has become the only thing remaining.

flavor: The throne is iron. The iron came from the earth. The earth does not forget.

name: The Lamp

fortuneText.upright: He stands apart from the company. The lamp he carries was lit there. Those still on the path will see it before they see him.
fortuneText.reversed: The lamp is shielded against weather that has already passed. The hand that holds it has forgotten the path it was meant for.

flavor: A small flame, carried at arm's length, by one who does not need it.

name: The Æon

fortuneText.upright: The trumpet calls all. The rising is mandatory. The choice was made when the sound began, and the sound began long ago.
fortuneText.reversed: The trumpet has sounded twice. The grave remains closed by the will of the one inside it. The sound does not stop for that.

flavor: The trumpet sounds. The dirt above the graves stirs.

name: The Tower

fortuneText.upright: The tower was false before the lightning knew it. The ground it stood on remains. What stood on the ground was never the ground.
fortuneText.reversed: The walls are buttressed against the inevitable. Each timber added is one more thing to fall when the rest does. The collapse is patient.

flavor: The lightning came for the foundation. The tower was incidental.

name: The Vessel

fortuneText.upright: The water passes between the jars. Each pour is the same weight. The one who pours has been doing so for longer than the work has taken.
fortuneText.reversed: The pour overshoots the rim. The water finds the floor. What was meant to be measured is now distributed by accident.

flavor: Water between two jars. Neither holds it for long.

name: The Hooded

fortuneText.upright: The world has been turned. The blood arrives at the head differently. What was familiar from above is unrecognizable from below.
fortuneText.reversed: The hanging has continued past the lesson. The figure has begun to call the rope a virtue. The ground waits where it has always waited.

flavor: He hangs by one foot. His eyes are open. His hands are loose at his sides.
